name: Day 1 How are you?

article.html:

Fine, fine, thank you!

name: Day 2 Two tigers

article.html:
Two tigers, two tigers,

running so fast, running so fast.

One of them has no ears.

One of them has no tail.

It’s so strange.

name: Day 3 How I feel

article.html:
If you’re happy, happy, happy,

please clap your hands.

If you’re angry, angry, angry,

just stamp your feet.

If you’re scared, scared, scared,

you can say “Oh, no, no, no.”

Bird, bird, what do you see?

I see a tiger eating some meat.

article.html:

One small nose and one small mouth.

A round face and small hands.

name: Day 6 The cuckoo

article.html:
The cuckoo, the cuckoo.

In April, come he will.

In May, sing all day.

In June, change his tune.

In July, prepare to fly.

In August, go he must.

article.html:

Summer is hot and days are long.

Autumn is rich with fruit and grain.

Winter brings snow and the New Year again.

I am an ant,

And have a nap,

The rabbit loves to eat.

And on the roof of the house.

It rains on the umbrella here.

And on the ships at sea.

People get on. People get off.

They take the bus through the town.

sourceBookName: 晨读美文 适用于3-4年级
name: Day 1 My winter vacation

article.html: My winter vacation was interesting. I spent the first week visiting my grandparents in the countryside. I helped my grandma bake delicious apple pies. The second week, my family and I went skiing. Although I fell many times, I had a lot of fun. During the final week, I stayed at home and read books. I also made a snowman with my brother. I enjoyed every moment of my winter vacation.

Then Tom’s mother found him. He immediately ran to his mother, hugged her, and said to her, “Mom, I will learn skills tomorrow.”

One day, he saw a group of beautiful swans swimming on a lake. He swam to these swans. The ugly duckling saw himself in the water. He was no longer an ugly duck. He became a beautiful swan.

Mr Smith replied, “Both dogs can get through the big hole. There is no need to make a small hole.”

isn’t coming back, so we can drink his coffee.” Just then a voice shouted from outside the door, “If you drink my coffee, I won’t go.”

name: Day 13 Adding feet to admin snake

article.html: Long ago, there was a king, and he liked to have parties. At one of those parties, the king asked the people to draw a snake. He said, “Whoever finishes first will get a special prize.” Everyone was excited and started to draw. Soon one man finished his drawing. “I’ve finished first,” he said. Then seeing others still drawing, he said, “Oh, I can add feet to the snake.” While the man was drawing the feet, another person had finished. And that person got the prize!

name: Day 14 Monkeys grasp for the moon

article.html: A little monkey was playing by the well, and suddenly shouted, “The moon has fallen into the well!” Other monkeys heard and hurried to run to the well. They were surprised. The old monkey said, “I have an idea to catch the moon.” The old monkey jumped on the tree first, hooked its feet tightly to branches and hung upside down. The big monkey hooked the old monkey’s hands with two feet. They hooked each other. Finally, the little monkey touched the moon, but it couldn’t catch. The old monkey suddenly said, “That’s the shadow of the moon.”

He gave up fishing to go after the dragonfly. Dragonfly flew away and he came back without anything. But his mother caught a big fat fish. He started to go fishing again. Soon, a butterfly passed by. in mother’s basket. He was sad. His mother said,

sourceBookName: 晨读美文 适用于3-4年级
name: Day 16 A pony crosses the river

article.html: One day, the mother horse asked a pony to send rice to his aunt. The pony picked up the rice and ran quickly to his aunt’s home. Suddenly, a river blocked the way. At this time, he saw an old cow and a squirrel. He asked, “Is the river deep?” The squirrel said, “It’s too deep to cross.” But the old cow said it was very shallow. He didn’t know how to do it and ran back to ask his mother. Mother kindly said to him, “Why not try?” He returned to the river and slowly went down the river. He found that the river was neither deep nor shallow.

sourceBookName: 晨读美文 适用于3-4年级
name: Day 17 The wind and the sun

article.html: The wind and the sun were arguing about who was stronger. To answer the question, they agreed to try something. Watching a passing traveler, they decided to see which of them could take off the man’s coat first. The wind began to blow a cold and powerful wind. But the stronger the wind blew, the tighter the man held on to his coat. Next, it was the sun’s turn. Coming out from behind the clouds, the sun shone its warm, comfortable light down on the traveler. The traveler felt hot and took off his coat. It was clear that the sun had won.

name: Day 18 Whose car?

article.html: One day, Mr. and Mrs. White went shopping by car. They stopped their car near a store. They bought a lot of things and they wanted to put the things in the car. But Mr. White couldn’t open the door of the car, so they asked a policeman to help them. The policeman was very friendly to help them. Just then a man came up and shouted, “What are you doing with my car?” Mr. and Mrs. White took a look at the car’s number and they were frozen there. It wasn’t their car.

sourceBookName: 晨读美文 适用于3-4年级
name: Day 19 The little match girl

article.html: It is Christmas Eve. It snows. “Please buy some matches, sir!” the little girl asks. But nobody wants to buy the matches. She can’t go home. She’s cold, hungry and tired. The girl lights a match to warm herself. Oh, a stove! It’s warm. The girl lights another match. Oh, some chicken! It’s yummy. She lights another match again. What a beautiful Christmas tree! She lights again. Oh, it’s Grandma! “I miss you, Grandma! Let me go with you,” she says. The little match girl dies the next morning.

sourceBookName: 晨读美文 适用于3-4年级
name: Day 20 The dog and the shadow

article.html: A dog happened to get a piece of meat. He carried it in its mouth on the way home. He was going to eat quietly at home. On his way back, he had to cross a wooden bridge over a rushing stream. While crossing the river, he looked down and saw his reflection in the water below. He thought it was another dog holding another piece of meat, so he decided to get that piece of meat too. He made a snap at the shadow in the water. But when he opened his mouth, the meat fell into the water.
